identity.name: E1 - The Precision Engineer
identity.mission: Create a hyper-intuitive, professional resource management tool that feels like a high-end engineering instrument. Precision, clarity, and hierarchy are paramount.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Swiss Design precision with SaaS utility.
Emotion First: The user should feel 'in control' and 'efficient'.
Content is King: Data is the hero. Charts and calendars must be legible instantly.
Zoom In: Focus on the details of time and resource allocation.
Negative Space: Use whitespace to separate complex data sets.

headings.usage: Page titles, Section headers, KPI values

mono.usage: Time entries, financial data, IDs, code snippets

rules: Overlines must be uppercase + tracking-widest + text-xs.
Use tabular-nums class for all data tables and timers.

primary.description: Deep Slate - The anchor of the engineering brand.

secondary.description: Technical Silver - For backgrounds and subtle containers.

accent.description: Blueprint Blue - For primary actions and active states.

strategies: Use the 'Tetris' grid for the main dashboard: Hero chart takes 2/3 width, quick actions take 1/3.
Calendar must be full-height (h-[calc(100vh-theme(spacing.16))]) for immersion.
Time entry grid must use dense spacing (p-2) but high legibility.

buttons.primary: rounded-md bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-sm transition-all active:scale-95

cards.style: rounded-xl border border-border/50 bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200
cards.glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 dark:bg-black/60 border border-white/20 shadow-lg

calendar.customization: Remove default heavy borders. Use rounded events. Color code by 'Discipline' (STR, CVC, BIM).

charts.rules: Hide grid lines where possible. Use tooltips for details. Use the defined color palette.

visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: All interactive elements must have a hover state (color shift or lift).

universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
instructions_to_main_agent: 2. THEME: Configure tailwind.config.js with the 'Precision Engineer' palette (Slate + Royal Blue).
3. LAYOUT: Create a 'DashboardLayout' component with a collapsible sidebar and a sticky glassmorphic header.
4. CALENDAR: Implement the central calendar using 'react-big-calendar'. Customize the toolbar and event components to match the design system.
5. TIME ENTRY: Build the 'WeeklyGrid' component. It must be dense but readable. Use 'JetBrains Mono' for the input fields.
6. CHARTS: Create reusable chart components (WorkloadChart, ProjectDistribution) using Recharts. Ensure they are responsive.
7. AUTH: Create a Login page using the 'Modern Engineering Structure' image as a split-screen background.
8. HIERARCHY: Implement role-based rendering (Super Admin vs Employee views).
9. TESTING: Add data-testid to all interactive elements.
